title: Dynamic Island theme (*.islandtheme.json)
description: A look of the Dynamic Island plasmoid as data only: no code, no QML, no images. Fields that are not listed here are ignored; a listed field with a value outside what is allowed makes the file invalid. A file is at most 64 kB.

schema.description: Version of this format. 1 is the only one so far; a file with a higher one is refused by an island that does not know it.

name.description: The theme's name, as it is shown in the list of looks.

style.description: The Appearance settings. A field that is left out takes the value of the `preset` the style starts from (Oxygen Metallic when that is left out too).

preset.description: The ready-made look this style starts from; "Reset to the preset" goes back to it.

material.description: metal: gradient, silver rim and gloss; flat: one surface; glass: clear with a hairline.

strong.description: High contrast: nothing translucent to read on or with.

blur.description: Blur what is behind the island (needs the native helper and KWin's Blur effect).

blurLevel.description: Frosting over the blurred background: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high.

top.description: Distance from the top of the screen, px.

offsetX.description: Horizontal position from the centre, px.

scale.description: Size of the whole island, percent.

radius.description: Corner roundness, percent of a full capsule.

fill.description: What the background is: one colour (`background`) or a gradient (`gradient*`).

background.description: The solid background: a colour, or "accent" for the system's accent colour.

gradientAngle.description: Degrees, as in CSS: 0 runs upwards, 90 to the right. Linear gradients only.

gradientStops.description: Two or three colours, evenly spread along the gradient.

control.description: Buttons, fields, selections: a colour, or "accent".

text.description: The text colour; "" chooses it by contrast with the background.

borderColor.description: "" is the material's own border colour.
